result.description: A fictional compact docking hub for minimalist workstations and creative labs, the HelioLink Thunder 2.0 combines dual DisplayPort output, three USB-C ports, and a high-power upstream connection for laptops and small-form-factor PCs. It is designed for desk organization and peripheral expansion rather than portable storage, with an aluminum enclosure, status LEDs, and plug-and-play operation across modern operating systems.
result.title: Northstar HelioLink Thunder 2.0 Docking Hub
